headline: OpenAI closes the Sora consumer app as planned
body: A quiet day. OpenAI shut down the consumer Sora video app, as it had announced in March, to focus on business tools; the API is due to follow in September. A product being pulled is a faint signal of Tech Backlash, so Reversion moved by a hair. Horizon Balance reads +1.94.
movers_note: The only mover was Reversion, up 0.04 (rounds to +0.0) from the Sora shutdown.
coming_up: Sora API scheduled to shut down in September
